summary.text: Shark Flow Lever is a Heavenly Court time path Immortal Gu House. Fairy Zi Wei names it among houses she still plans to construct for a four-house barrier in the River of Time.

claims.text: After checking Fang Yuan and Spectral Soul, Fairy Zi Wei still cannot drop her unease and goes to Duke Long. He traces it to Red Lotus, because only Red Lotus among the three Demon Venerables who attacked Heavenly Court almost destroyed fate Immortal Gu. When he asks about the search for that true inheritance, she answers that Present and Past Pavilion is already in the River of Time, and that Eternal Yacht is almost completed and will enter after a few days to search with it.

When three Immortal Gu Houses chase Fang Yuan in the River of Time, the right house is a huge lever white like jade, with a rank eight Gu Immortal in blue star armor standing on it, and seven huge sharks with sharp teeth dragging the lever ahead. Fang Yuan counts three rank seven Immortal Gu Houses in that chase. Even Shark Flow Lever is hit in the sudden spring river segment. Later it and Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform fall far behind, and only Eternal Yacht can still catch him.

Xing Ye Wang, a rank eight star path expert woken from Heavenly Court’s immortal graveyard, stands on Shark Flow Lever and looks at Fang Yuan with deep battle intent. When Fang Yuan’s immemorial year monkey pounces toward Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform, Xing Ye Wang moves Shark Flow Lever to intercept. Spring scissors shrink in front of the house, then grow large at the shark lever and snip off two huge shark heads. Xing Ye Wang moves the house aside because he needs to handle that move. After the initial burst he repairs Shark Flow Lever and charges over again, shouting that Fang Yuan now faces four Immortal Gu Houses together.

Xing Ye Wang on Shark Flow Lever tries to stop Year End Gatehouse and fails. He later moves the lever to attack Fang Yuan’s back as Fang Yuan goes for a stone lotus island, and Bing Sai Chuan blocks Shark Flow Lever.

Summer fan then sends Shark Flow Lever and Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform into a tornado outside the river suppression lotus sealing formation. They reenter, erupt with powerful attacks on Bing Sai Chuan’s light shield, and help suppress Fang Yuan and Longevity Heaven.

Heavenly Court’s remaining time path Immortal Gu Houses are only rank seven. The three houses that still stand, including Shark Flow Lever, retreat through a tributary after Present and Past Pavilion stays behind.

After Eternal Yacht’s construction fails, Fairy Zi Wei tells Duke Long that she still plans to construct Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform, Shark Flow Lever, and Moment Stage, so five time path Immortal Gu Houses can keep Fang Yuan from Red Lotus true inheritances even if Heavenly Court cannot find them.

When Myriad Year Flying Warship meets a river suppression lotus sealing formation trap, Shark Flow Lever appears with Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform. Those two houses’ constructions had begun long ago, were completed recently, and are sent into this battle. Shark Flow Lever draws an arc at the periphery, picks up Li Huang, and joins the fight. Li Huang is a fire path Gu Immortal and can only fight in the River of Time with Shark Flow Lever.

Heavenly Court’s two time path Immortal Gu Houses are both rank seven and can match rank eight battle strength against most year beasts. Li Huang is inside Shark Flow Lever when the warship charges into it. He controls the huge sharks in front to bite immemorial year beasts, and activates Shark Flow Lever’s killer move. Within a dozen breaths two immemorial year beasts are beaten to death one after the other. Fang Yuan clings the warship onto Shark Flow Lever or Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform so the year beasts’ rush also hits those houses. Combined torrential charge and daybreak swords then collide into the damaged Shark Flow Lever. The house is directly destroyed, and the remaining huge sharks die on the spot.

When five Immortal Gu Houses chase Myriad Year Flying Warship, Bai Ning Bing and the rest note that Heavenly Court also has Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform, Shark Flow Lever, and a mysterious Immortal Gu House besides the rebuilt Present and Past Pavilion and Eternal Yacht.

Four Immortal Gu Houses fly above the River of Time toward a stone lotus island. Shark Flow Lever is again white like jade, with seven huge sharks dragging the lever ahead. Gu Liu Ru orders Shark Flow Lever and Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform to patrol the surroundings and report anything that shows up, while he leads Moment Stage, Feng Jiu Ge leads Present and Past Pavilion, and Eternal Yacht moves to a tributary entrance for reinforcements.

When Myriad Year Flying Warship appears, the two patrolling houses change direction to obstruct it. Shark Flow Lever arrives shortly after Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform. It shoots out three frost waves and freezes the water of the River of Time under the warship. After Moment Stage collides with the warship, Shark Flow Lever and Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform stall the warship’s advance.

Among Moment Stage, Present and Past Pavilion, Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform, Eternal Yacht, Shark Flow Lever, and Sun and Moon Temple, Heavenly Court surrounds the warship. Gu Liu Ru sends Eternal Yacht and Shark Flow Lever out of the battlefield. After leaving, those two houses shine with bright light, and two auras resembling Years Flow Like Water spread out, drawing most of the forming year beast tide toward them. Once myriad year hunting is restricted, Shark Flow Lever returns to the encirclement, and Xing Ye Wang moves it to assault with deep killing intent. When Heavenly Court tries to leave, daybreak swords shoot toward Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform and Shark Flow Lever.

After that River of Time battle, Shark Flow Lever is completely destroyed without a single Immortal Gu left. It had a special construction style that used a combination of desolate beasts and Immortal Gu. While taking loot from the battlefield, Fang Yuan reverse-deduces most of its contents from the clues he finds, which inspires his clone’s deductions toward incorporating Twelve Zodiac battle formation into Myriad Year Flying Warship.
